# ICP: Platform teams at self-hosted B2B SaaS
*v2 — buyer confirmed by the founder*

## Must-have
- B2B SaaS that runs its own Kubernetes clusters (confidence: validated; source: founder)
- Buyer: VP or Head of Platform Engineering (confidence: validated; source: founder)

## Nice-to-have
- 200-2,000 employees (confidence: inferred; source: website)
- Reachable via: KubeCon EU sponsor list (confidence: needs validation; source: founder)

## Disqualifiers
- Runs only on a fully managed PaaS, no own clusters (confidence: validated; source: founder)

## Anti-ICP
- Web agencies building client sites: no platform team, never buy (confidence: validated; source: lost examples)

## Top pains (ranked)
1. On-call load from noisy Kubernetes alerts (confidence: validated; source: founder)
2. Slow environment provisioning for developers (confidence: inferred; source: website)

## Buying triggers
- Hiring an SRE or platform engineer (confidence: validated; source: founder)
- A public outage postmortem (confidence: inferred; source: website)

## Changelog
- v1 (2026-09-12): first version, because founder interview
- v2 (2026-10-01): buyer confirmed, because founder answer
